sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report relates to customer C10434 and card C10434-K1 regarding suspected card-not-present fraud. On 2016-12-02 at 15:18:27, an online transaction (ID 3506725) was attempted for $1,000.03 under product code R in region 469. The transaction was conducted using device profile D000253 (Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768), which was recorded as new for this account. The transaction amount of $1,000.03 represents an extreme deviation (z=4.9) from the cardholder's baseline of 33 prior transactions averaging $131.25. The supervised model utilizing over 60 graph-derived features generated a calibrated fraud probability of 0.90. The activity matches typologies for Pattern 3 (Card-not-present fraud from a new device) and Pattern 2 (Card-not-present fraud). Additionally, device profile D000253 has been observed on 209 cards, including 10 confirmed-fraud closed cases. Total financial exposure is $1,000.03, which exceeds the $1,000 filing threshold. The financial institution has taken risk mitigation actions by blocking card C10434-K1, creating case HHG-010, and submitting this report.
